topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Rain's been drummin' on the window since dawn. Figured I'd pick up a game of solitaire, wait for the phone to ring, maybe it wouldn't. Then there's this knock, like a punk kid with nothin' to lose. Open the door, and there she is, a face I thought only existed over wires and pixels. We met through a screen, in a world where every pixel might as well be a lie. She's from the other side of this concrete jungle, and now she's standin' in the doorway. I don't know if I should pour her a drink or call the cops. Padres must've gotten to her. Or maybe, just maybe, she got somethin' I need. Who the hell knows anymore? The rain keeps fallin', and the city's a labyrinth of shadows and secrets. I just hope this one doesn't end in too many empty bottles.
